item.description: It's SEC Media Days 2026, and "Beat Everyone" is in Tampa! AL.com Alabama beat reporter and pod correspondent Nick Kelly is on the scene gathering intel and talking to the best in the college football media business about the Crimson Tide's upcoming season. Nick talks to Brooks Austin ("The Film Guy"), On3's Andy Staples, and ESPN's Dari Nowkhah about Kalen DeBoer, the quarterback battle, Bama's offensive line, and MUCH more!

item.title: Is Alabama football SOFT? 👶 How will Crimson Tide get some RESPECT?
item.author: Alabama Crimson Tide on AL.com
item.description: The best college football program that prides itself in dishing out joyless murderball can't be...soft...can it? AL.com columnist Joe Goodman joins Ben Flanagan to break down the national perception of Kalen DeBoer's team heading into the 2026 season. Is anyone confident they can compete to win a national championship? Plus, some thoughts on Nate Oats' future in Tuscaloosa, and we ask: Who is the Alabama football of the 2026 World Cup?

item.title: The TRUTH behind Alabama's most VIRAL moments! with SIMONE ELI
item.author: Alabama Crimson Tide on AL.com
item.description: Alabama is a worldwide brand. Everybody watches the Crimson Tide on Saturdays, so it doesn't take much for Bama to go viral online and create iconic memes and moments fans will never forget. New York-based sports anchor and PIX11 News host Simone Eli had one of the most unforgettable moments in a postgame interview with former Alabama cornerback Tony Brown, who Mac Jones called his "craziest teammate." Eli tells the story behind the incredible video and ranks the most viral moments in Alabama history on "Beat Everyone."

item.title: Does Alabama football have a recruiting PROBLEM? Why are Tide fans so WORRIED?!
item.author: Alabama Crimson Tide on AL.com
item.description: Is Alabama football recruiting really a disaster, or is this a false alarm? The Crimson Tide are either ranked low or not at all on major services tracking which programs are attracting the best high school talent in the country, causing concern for fans and dripping some blood in the water for trolls. Matt Scalici joins Ben Flanagan to break down where Kalen DeBoer and Bama actually stand on the recruiting front and how fans should feel several months away from the early signing period.
